project.name: ForwardMeasure JPA Testcontainers
project.description:
JUnit 5 test infrastructure that hands a test class a real, already-migrated tenant schema - @WithMigratedTenantSchema composes forwardmeasure-testcontainers-junit-jupiter's real PostgreSQL container with forwardmeasure-jpa-liquibase's real TenantSchemaMigrator, so consumers (this repo's own contract tests, and downstream product repos such as forwardmeasure-entity-intelligence) never hand-roll their own container+migration plumbing. Mirrors the role data-fabric's real @WithPostgreSQLTestContainer + IntegrationTestBase play there (one shared, reusable piece of test infrastructure, not copy-pasted setup per test class) - adapted for a plain-JUnit5, framework-neutral application layer, since data-fabric's own version is a @QuarkusTestResource tied to Quarkus dev-services and this repo has no such single-framework anchor.
Deliberately its own module, not folded into forwardmeasure-jpa-liquibase itself: TenantSchemaMigrator is also used by real production migration-runner code, which must never pull JUnit/Testcontainers onto its runtime classpath. A module by this same name and package existed before a prior refactor deleted it outright (a bare PostgreSQL container wrapper with no Liquibase integration at all, confirmed via git history) - this is a different, Liquibase-integrated replacement, not a restoration of that old content.
